title: Loop Jamming Candidate (Separated Redundant Iteration)
damaged_code:
```vb
For i = 0 To count - 1
    names(i) = ""
Next
'... other operations
For i = 0 To count - 1
    earnings(i) = 0
Next
```
pattern: Two separate loops iterating over the exact same index range and modifying adjacent arrays or structures.
why_bad: Incurs double the loop branch overhead and requires loading the indices/cache lines into memory twice instead of coalescing accesses.
detection: Sequential loop blocks with identical bounds and loop variables.
counterexample: Jamming the loops introduces order-of-execution bugs or degrades cache performance due to too many variables in the combined loop body. `Contextual`.
fix: Jam/merge the two loop bodies into a single loop block.
